analysis.one_line_summary: Creator transforms big, frizzy curly hair into a smooth, voluminous blowout using the Wavytalk Blowout Boost thermal brush.
analysis.full_description: A vertical UGC tutorial video featuring a young creator styling her voluminous, frizzy curly hair with the Wavytalk Blowout Boost. The video starts with a quick before-and-after flash hook displaying her frizzy 'Before' state followed immediately by her glossy, styled 'After' look. It then cuts to a demonstration showing her sectioning and gliding the heated round brush through her hair to smooth and curl the ends. The ad concludes with a showcase of the finished, shiny blowout result set to upbeat pop music.

on_screen_text.text: Style my curly hair with me!

scenes.visual: Young woman sitting in front of window blinds smiling, showing extremely voluminous, frizzy brushed-out dark curly hair.
scenes.action: Smiles and tilts head showing the 'Before' hair state.

scenes.visual: Quick flash forward to the creator with smooth, glossy, voluminous blowout curls.
scenes.action: Poses and smiles displaying the 'After' hair result.

scenes.visual: Creator holding the Wavytalk Blowout Boost thermal round brush, working through a side section of hair.
scenes.action: Glides the thermal brush down her hair shaft and rolls the ends outward into a curl.

scenes.visual: Creator styling the front crown section of her hair.
scenes.action: Places the brush under the roots, pulls upward and curls the section smooth.

scenes.visual: Creator lifting and styling the top back section of hair.
scenes.action: Rolls the brush through the top layer to add lift and volume.

scenes.visual: Creator working on the remaining side section of frizzy hair.
scenes.action: Smooths the section from root to tip and rotates the barrel to create a bouncy curl.

scenes.visual: Creator showcasing the complete, styled blowout hairstyle with smooth body and defined curls.
scenes.action: Gently sways shoulders and smiles proudly at the camera showing the finished look.

hook.first_frame: Creator facing camera showing frizzy curly hair with text 'Style my curly hair with me! Before'.
hook.visual_0_3s: Fast cut from frizzy, brushed-out curly hair ('Before') to smooth salon-grade blowout ('After!').
hook.text_0_3s: Style my curly hair with me! Before / After!
hook.pattern_interrupt: Rapid 1-second flash from wild frizzy hair directly into a pristine blowout before showing the process.

narrative_beats: Before teaser hook showing frizzy texture
Instant result preview showing sleek blowout
Tool introduction and step-by-step styling demo
key_claims: Tames and straightens frizzy, thick curly hair
Creates salon-worthy blowout waves at home
pain_points: Frizzy, unruly curly hair that is hard to tame
Difficulty achieving a bouncy salon blowout on thick curly hair
objections_handled: Does it work on frizzy/thick curly hair?

talent.hair_before: Brunette, thick, frizzy, brushed-out curly hair, shoulder to chest length
talent.hair_after: Smooth, glossy, bouncy brunette blowout with defined curved ends

audio_and_edit.music_description: Pop track ('Who Says' by Selena Gomez & The Scene)
audio_and_edit.ending: Creator smiles warmly at the camera displaying bouncy blowout curls.

analysis.notes: Silent UGC-style demo format driven by music track and concise text overlays. Highly visual before/after transformation hook targeting curly and frizzy hair types.
